transcript.text: Good morning. I'd like to get our weekly logistics review started so we can finalize the temperature-controlled bay schedule for this week. We have two windows available — Tuesday 0600 through Wednesday 1800, and Thursday 1200 through Friday 1800 — and both medical supplies and avionics batteries need the bay. Before we settle assignments, I need to understand each of your requirements and timelines. Let's hear from both the medical and signal logistics officers on when your respective receipts are expected and how long you'll need the bay.

transcript.text: I confirmed with the clinic warehouse this morning that the medical shipment arrives Tuesday at 0600 and must remain in temperature-controlled storage through Wednesday at 1800. The receiving manifest has not yet been added to the battalion storage schedule. The clinic also requires a temperature log every 4 hours during that window.

transcript.text: I confirmed with the battery technician that the avionics battery shipment is scheduled for the Thursday window — Thursday 1200 through Friday 1800 — and requires a charge-status verification at Thursday 1200 before storage.
